name: realtor/search
description: Get Realtor.com listings from a search results URL with address, price, beds, baths, size, status and listing link.

url.description: Realtor.com city_STATE or ZIP search URL under /realestateandhomes-search/ or /apartments/. Alpha: availability may vary by location or property.

limit.description: Listings per results page, from 1 to 200.

timeout.description: Seconds the data source may spend before giving up (max 50, default 50). A timed-out call is not billed.
